rounds.text: Cords Cable Industries Ltd trades at an attractive P/E of 12.7x and a P/B of 1.30x against sector benchmarks of 27.45x and 4.69x, pointing to a stark valuation gap [E1, E2, E6, E7]. The company exhibits robust fundamental momentum, demonstrated by a 5-year compounded profit growth of 37% and trailing twelve-month profit growth of 41% [E19, E21], comfortably outpacing sector median profit growth of 20.4% [E71]. Cash generation is exceptionally strong with a cash conversion of 2.05x, yielding Rs 43 Cr in operating cash flow and Rs 33 Cr in free cash flow for March 2026 [E34, E35, E36]. Furthermore, borrowings have declined from Rs 116 Cr to Rs 103 Cr year-over-year [E39], and the quantitative rules-based screen awards the company a high-confidence BUY score of 91 out of 100 [E63]. Conceded: the company has a low 3-year return on equity of 8.50% and significant contingent liabilities of Rs. 156 Cr [E60, E61].
